title: Grid-Based Global Clock Distribution with Sector Buffers
decision: Implemented a hierarchical clock network utilizing a grid of sector buffers driving local clock grids across the dual-core chip.
alternatives_or_rejected: A pure tree-based clock network without sector grid meshes or an unbuffered global mesh.
rationale: Pure clock trees are highly vulnerable to localized process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) variations and dynamic IR drop across a large die (>400 mm²), while an unbuffered mesh consumes excessive power. Sector buffers driving local grids provide low clock skew while bounding power dissipation.
outcome: Achieved tight clock skew control across all core and L2 logic regions at gigahertz operating frequencies.

title: Selective Dynamic Compound Domino Logic in Execution Datapaths
decision: Applied dynamic compound domino logic selectively to delay-critical execution datapaths (such as fixed-point and floating-point ALUs and rotators), while using static CMOS for non-critical control logic.
alternatives_or_rejected: Widespread use of dynamic logic throughout control and datapath, or relying exclusively on static CMOS.
rationale: Static CMOS was insufficient to achieve target single-cycle delay budgets in execution pipelines. However, unconstrained dynamic logic increases noise vulnerability, dynamic power, and verification complexity, making selective application necessary.
outcome: Met aggressive sub-nanosecond clock cycle targets in core execution paths while controlling chip power and noise margins.

title: SOI Floating-Body History-Effect Delay Modeling Methodology
decision: Developed custom circuit design rules and specialized static timing analysis methods to explicitly bound floating-body history effects in partially depleted SOI (PD-SOI).
alternatives_or_rejected: Standard bulk-CMOS timing analysis models assuming static threshold voltages.
rationale: In PD-SOI processes, body voltages fluctuate based on prior switching activity, causing history-dependent threshold voltage shifts. Ignoring these shifts causes unexpected hold time failures or false setup passes in timing analysis.
outcome: Eliminated history-effect timing race conditions and ensured physical signoff timing accurately reflected hardware silicon behavior.

title: Hierarchical Design Partitioning using Custom and Random Logic Macros
decision: Partitioned the chip hierarchically into full-custom macros (for datapath/arrays) and Random Logic Macros (RLMs) for control logic, bound by strict timing budgets at macro boundaries.
alternatives_or_rejected: Flat automated place-and-route flow across the full microprocessor die.
rationale: Flat implementation tools could not scale to manage 170 million transistors across 400+ mm² die area, nor could automated P&R hit the tight timing bounds required for core execution units.
outcome: Enabled parallel development across multiple engineering teams and successfully achieved timing closure on a high-frequency dual-core processor.
